title: The IPv4 checksum
description:
Compute and check the header checksum of an IPv4 packet.

```
header: 45 00 00 73 00 00 40 00 40 11 [00 00] c0 a8 00 01 c0 a8 00 c7
computed checksum: 0xb861
check a received header: valid
one byte changed: invalid
```
requirements: Add the header as 16-bit big-endian words, fold the carries back in, and take the one's complement.
The checksum field counts as 0 while computing.
A received header is valid when the sum including its checksum folds to 0xFFFF.
stretch: Compute a UDP checksum, which also covers a "pseudo-header" with the addresses.
